notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (9): Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe (posted 'Set Your Course For Alderan/???'), Start Your Engines!, Watto's Box, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Death Star, Alderaan and Death Star: Docking Bay 327; these count toward the total.
The deck totals 58 cards as published: the Interrupts header says 24 but the cards listed under it add up to 22. Kept as published.
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the list plays the Coruscant-set Neimoidian Advisor and Masterful Move & Endor Occupation.

Dark printings used for the two-sided names: Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Alderaan (Dark), Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark). Death Star: Docking Bay 327 is posted once in Starting and x3 under Locations; kept as published (4 copies of a unique site).

Posted 'Hoth Echo War Room' dested the Dark Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room) (Dark), the Dark Rebel Base war room Responsibility Of Command deploys on (the strategy's 'ROC+MAIH'); 'Death Star War Room' dested Death Star: War Room.

Posted 'DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Dath Maul' Darth Maul (Tatooine), kept x2 as published; 'IG-88 w/gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Neimodian Advisor' Neimoidian Advisor; 'Podrace Collision' Podracer Collision; 'Omni Box/It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.

Posted combos: 'Sense/Uncertain is the Future' Sense & Uncertain Is The Future; 'Masterful Move/Endor Occupation' Masterful Move & Endor Occupation; 'Alter/Collateral Damage' Alter & Collateral Damage; 'Control/Set for stun' Control & Set For Stun.
Come Here You Big Coward is the Special Edition Effect (listed under Effects), not a Defensive Shield.
